༄༅/ /gnyis ka'i yang yig nam mkha' klong chen bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gnyis ka'i yang yig nam mkha' klong chen bzhugs so/ /

nam mkha' klong chen zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan yon tan dam pa'i gzhir gyur cing*/ /rgyal ba rgyal sras yid bzhin 'byung ba'i mdzod/ /chos dbyings dri med shin tu rnam dag pa/ /mi g.yo spros dang bral la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang sngags kun gyi mthar thug snying po'i don/ /mngon sum 'od gsal rdo rje snying po ni/ /kun dang mthun zhing kun las 'phags pa'i tshul/ /lung bzhin mdor bsdus nas ni gsal bar bya/ /gzhi dbyings lam dang rnam grol 'bras bu las/ /dbyings ni 'od gsal rang bzhin lhun gyis grub/ /stong dang gsal dang rig pa'i snying po can/ /rnam par dbyer med yon tan tshogs mang ldan/ /nyi bzhin lhun grub rang bzhin rnam par dag /rnam dbyer bcas pa'i dri mas ye stong zhing*/ /gdod nas rnam dag 'od gsal chos nyid do/ /'di yod pas na rig dang ma rig las/ /mya ngan 'das dang 'gro drug snang ba shar/ /shar tsam nyid nas snying po'i dbyings de la/ /bzang ngan 'pho 'gyur dag dang ma dag med/ /ji ltar nam mkha'i dbyings na 'byung bzhi yi/ /'pho 'gyur snang bas gos pa med pa bzhin/ /kun gyi go 'byed 'byung gnas dbyings zhes bya/ /dri bcas sems rten rang bzhin lhun grub pas/ /sems nyid rang bzhin 'od gsal zhes bya zhing*/ /nyi dang sprin bzhin glo bur dri ma yis/ /bsgribs phyir khams zhes dus ring nyid gnas phyir/ / thog med chos khams dge ba zhes brjod cing*/ /gnas lugs yin phyir don dam bden par brtags/ /bsam yul 'das phyir shes rab pha rol phyin/ / 'dus ma byas phyir lhun grub dkyil 'khor nyid/ /stobs sogs yon tan rgya mtsho'i mdzod nyid phyir/ /bde gshegs snying pos 'gro kun khyab ces gsungs/ /rang la yod kyang ma mthong bsgribs pa'i dpes/ /sa 'og gter dang bum nang mar me dang*/ /sbun pa'i 'bras dang sa nang bde gshegs

dang*/ /gos rul rin chen 'dam rdzab nor bu dang*/ /pad nang sbrang rtsi rdo khams rin chen dang*/ /gyad kyi nor bu dngul 'dam gser nyid dang*/ /ljon shing 'bras dang 'o ma'i mar nyid dang*/ /stong gsum dar yug chen po la sogs pas/ /nye bar mtshon te lung las gsungs de bzhin/ /rig khams snying pos 'gro kun yongs la khyab/ /'di ni nges don snying po'i gzhi zhes bya/ / de lta'i dbyings las rang rig rnam grol zhing*/ /skad cig bye brag phyed pas sangs rgyas te/ /gdod ma'i mgon po yon tan pha rol phyin/ /nang gi ji bzhin gzigs pa rnam dag pas/ /dang po sangs rgyas chos tshogs rnam par gzhag dus ring brtag dka' thog ma med dbyings su/ /ma rig dbang gis 'gro drug 'khrul pa ni/ /sems can chung ngu ngan song gsum dang ni/ /'bring po mi dang chen po lha nyid de/ /ma rig las byung rgyal bas gsungs de bzhin/ /rang rang gnas dang longs spyod bde sdug rnams/ /gnyid myos pa las rmi lam shar ba bzhin/ /snang srid snod bcud sna tshogs mngon par snang*/ /bde gshegs snying po don gyi kun gzhi'i steng*/ /dang po ma rig shes bzhin lung ma bstan/ /bag chags sna tshogs kun gzhi 'khor ba rten/ /de las kun gzhi'i rnam shes nyid dang ni/ /sgo lnga'i shes dang dpyod byed yid dang ni/ /nyon mongs can yid rnam shes tshogs brgyad shar/ /de yis las dang nyon mongs 'dus byas te/ /yul dang don dang lus su bag chags pas/ /'khrul snang sna tshogs bde sdug rgyun mi 'chad/ /zo chu'i khyud mo bzhin du 'khor ba yin/ /mdor na 'khor bar 'khrul ba'i rtsa ba ni/ /ma rig nyid de de las gzung dang 'dzin/ /de las las dang nyon mongs 'dus byas pas/ /'bras bu srid pa'i bde sdug sna tshogs snang*/ /rkyen las skyes phyir glo bur 'dus byas phyir/ /mi bden bslu ba 'khrul pa'i rang bzhin yin/ /g.yo ba'i kun rtog gis sprul 'jig rten pa/

/mi brtan 'jig pa'i chos de 'dus byas phyir/ /ma rig mi 'dra de las gzung 'dzin gyis/ /'du byed skyes bu'i mtheb mdzub dang 'dra zhing*/ /las ni 'phen byed gzhu mo'i srad bu 'dra/ / len pa ltong 'dra sems can mda' dang 'dra/ /nyon mongs 'bem 'dra bde sdug so sor snang*/ /de phyir kun 'byung las skyes 'bras bu ni/ /sdug bsngal nyon mongs kyis mnar 'khor ba pa/ /las zad nyon mongs grol ba'i go skabs dka'/ /skad cig skad cig kun rtog rgyu las ni/ /'bras bu phyi phyir bde sdug ngang gis 'byung*/ /de bas de las ldog pa'i thabs 'tshal lo/ /de 'dra'i 'khor ba nyes mang mtsho gter las/ /bsgral phyir rgyal bas chos kyi gru gsungs te/ /sna tshogs theg pa'i 'jug sgo bsam mi khyab/ /'di ni mthar thug nges pa'i snying po yin/ /mdo rgyud man ngag rtse mo 'od gsal lam/ / bde gshegs snying po'i gnas lugs ji lta bar/ /mngon sum nyams su len pa'i man ngag don/ /'khor ba sbyang phyir myang 'das mngon gyur phyir/ /stong dang snang ba'i 'jug sgo rnam pa gnyis/ khregs chod dang ni thod rgal zhes bya 'o/ /dang po khregs chod don gyi dgongs pa ni/ /'khor ba'i 'khrul snang 'khrul rtog ji snyed kun/ /glo bur yin phyir bsgrib phyir bslu ba'i phyir/ /rkyen las skyes phyir 'jig phyir mi bden phyir/ /sems dang sems byung sems kyi snang ba kun/ /mi rtag mi bden gsog gsob ya ma brla/ /sgyu ma smig rgyu chu yi zla ba dang*/ /sgra brnyan sprul pa dri za'i grong dang ni/ /brag cha rmi lam bzhin du ngo bo med/ /rab rib can la skra shad snang ba bzhin/ /med pa gsal snang rten 'byung rgyu 'bras nyid/ /snang dus nyid nas rang bzhin 'gags med pas/ /'khor ba'i chos kun ye nas ma skyes so/ /ji ltar rmi lam sgyu ma'i skye 'gags ltar/ /skye bar snang yang ma skyes stong pa'i ngang*/

/gnas par snang yang mi gnas stong pa'i ngang*/ /'gags par snang yang mi 'gag 'gag rgyu med/ /ye nas med pas skye ba mi srid cing*/ /ma skyes pa las gnas pa ga la srid/ /mi gnas pa de nam yang 'gag tu med/ /ji ltar mo gsham bu yi skye 'gags bzhin/ /ming tsam brda tsam snang ngor btags pa tsam/ /dpyad na gzugs ni cha shas dngos med pas/ /mo gsham bu 'dra rang bzhin med pa nyid/ /sgra dang dri ro reg dang yid kyi chos/ /don gyi 'dzin pa rtog pa'i rang bzhin yang*/ kha dog ngos gzung dus gsum dpyad pas na/ /cha shas dngos med mo gsham bu 'dra bar/ /gcig dang du ma'i rang bzhin mi dmigs pas/ /mkha' 'dra ma skyes gdod nas dag pa nyid/ /de ltar dpyad na gang 'khor gang zhig 'khor/ /'khor dang 'khor sa med pa'i chos rnams la/ / dngos po bdag tu 'dzin pas ci zhig bya/ /sems snang chos 'di gzhi med stong pa ste/ /bdag med spros dang bral zhing mtshan ma med/ /gdod nas ma skyes rang bzhin rnam par dag /rnam kun stong pa'i cho 'phrul snang ba tsam/ / phyi rol snang 'di gzung ba'i yul med de/ /cha shas dngos med rang bzhin kun dang bral/ /de nyid 'dzin pa'i sems 'di dngos med de/ kha dog dbyibs med ngo bo ngos gzung med/ /de phyir chos kun ma skyes stong pa'i ngang*/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa gnyis med zung 'jug med/ /gcig dang tha dad bral ba'i chos nyid do/ /'khor ba med pas sems ngor snang ba yi/ /mya ngan 'das med rten med chos can bzhin/ /ltos pa log pas ltos chos ldog pa nyid/ /mya ngan med pas mya ngan 'das pa med/ /las dang nyon mongs bde sdug 'khrul pa yang*/ /rang bzhin 'gags med nam mkha'i me tog bzhin/ / rnam kun med snang stong par la bzla 'o/ /mdor na 'khor bas bsdus pa'i chos rnams kun/ /kun brtags nyid phyir stong dang mtshan ma med/ /rang bzhin chad phyir sprul pa sgyu ma bzhin/ /don la med par yang dag mkhyen par mdzod/

/de ltar 'khrul pa mi bden bslu ba'i phyir/ /ma 'khrul bslu med snying po'i don la 'jug /de yang snang srid dngos dang dngos med kun/ /rang bzh-in stong pa'i ngang du thag chod nas/ /phyi nang yul sems gang yang mi bsam par/ /rang gsal spros dang bral ba'i ngang der sgoms/ /'byung 'jug re dogs chad pa'i byang chub sems/ /gtad bzhag 'gro 'ong med pa'i don mthong 'gyur/ /'di ni nges don mdo rgyud kun la gsungs/ /spros kun zhi bas khregs chod ces su btags/ /de nas thod rgal don gyi gnas lugs ni/ /snying po'i khams de dngos su lam du byed/ /de yang rang rig gdod ma'i dbyings de nyid/ /ngo bo stong pas mtshan mar med na yang*/ /rang bzhin gsal bas 'od gsal kha dog ldan/ /thugs rje rig pa'i gnad de goms bya ba/ /bum nang mar me bum pa'i khar gsal ltar/ /chu yi sgron mas shel gyi rtsa nang nas/ /rang gdangs 'od lnga thig le'i gdangs gsal ba/ /sprin bral mkha' dbyings dag pa'i klong du shar/ /de nyid mthong bas rig gdangs mthong ba'i phyir/ /chos nyid mngon sum snang ba mthong zhes brjod/ /de yang 'bras ming rgyu la btags pa ste/ /nyi ma'i zer la nyi mar btags pa bzhin/ /gzhal bya'i don la rab tu mi bslu bar/ /'khrul snang mthong las khyad par phye ba ni/ /nor bu sgron me'i 'od la der zhen pas/ /ldog par 'dra yang don byed khyad zhugs bzhin/ /sgom dus 'od gsal snang ba mchog tu bshad/ /tha mal snang 'di 'khrul pa nyid yin pas/ /de la sor gzhag 'khrul snang phyi phyir 'phel/ /de bzhin 'khrul rtog lam du sus byed pa/ / 'khrul pa'i rgyu 'bras nyid las thar dus med/ /de bas ma 'khrul 'od gsal snang ba dang*/ /sems 'gags ye shes lam du byed pa gces/ /de yang mi g.yo mnyam par bzhag pa'i tshe/ /'od gsal dmigs gtad rig pa dwangs phyed pas/ /gnas lugs gcig la snang lugs nyams gsum skyes/ /ngo bo'i gdangs las mi rtog spros dang bral/

/rang bzhin gdangs las rang gsal gsal dwangs phyed/ /thugs rje'i gdangs las rig bde rgyun mi chad/ /sku gsum nyams ni nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /de nyid goms pas snang ba rnam bzhi las/ /dang po chos nyid mngon sum dus nyid du/ /tshogs lam dang ni nyams rtogs mtshungs pa ste/ /lus tshor sems chos zhen pa ngang gis bral/ /dge 'phel gnad kyis mi dge ngang gis 'grib/ /ting 'dzin grub pas mngon shes rdzu 'phrul 'grub/ /de nas nyams snang gong du 'phel ba'i tshe/ /sbyor lam nyid mtshungs dad dang brtson 'grus ldan/ /dran pa ting 'dzin shes rab dbang 'byor zhing*/ /nyon mongs phyogs bcom stobs chen gnyen po nyid/ /shig sro med cing rmi lam nyid kyang dag /ngan song rgyun chad bden pa'i tshig kyang 'grub/ /de nas rig pa tshad phebs snang ba ni/ /thog ma bar dang tha ma'i rim pa bzhin/ /mthong sgom zhing dang ting 'dzin rdzu 'phrul sogs/ / gong nas gong mthor khams kyi yon tan mthong*/ /de yang rdza bum shel lam 'ja' tshon du/ /rim gyis 'gyur dpe'i mar me snang ba ltar/ khams la sgrib pa'i dri ma dag stobs kyi/ /yon tan gong 'phel gsar du snang ba bzhin/ / don la snga phyir yon tan 'phel grib med/ /sprin mthongs nyi bzhin bde gshegs snying po'i don/ /mngon du mthong bas dpes gsung rig par bya/ / de yang bus pa btsas ma thag pa yis/ khyim nang mthongs las nyi ma mthong ba dang*/ /bar mas khang steng rgan po'i ri rtse nas/ /nyi mthongs bzhin te mthong sgom chos nyid 'dra/ /de yang nyi ma mthong bar khyad med ltar/ /bde gshegs snying po mthong bar khyad med kyang*/ /nyi 'od snang ba mthong gang yul gru gcig /rgyal khams khyab mthong bzhin du snying po yi/ /rang 'od yon tan mthong ba'i khyad par che/ /ji ltar mthong zin don de sgom pa nas/ /sgom lam nyid dang rnam pa 'dra na yang*/ /gsar du snang bas yon tan mi 'dra ba/ /nyi dang nyi 'od mthong ba'i dpes shes bya/

/don 'dir chos nyid rtogs pa'i rang bzhin la/ /gsal dang mi gsal rgya ni che chung gis/ khyad par gnyis ka ltar yin dpes mtshon na/ /dmus long rab rib can dang mig dag pas/ /nyi ma mjal tshe dmus long ci la mjal/ /rab rib can gyis cung zad ma dag mthong*/ /mig dag pas ni sgrib pa med mthong bzhin/ /so so skye bo dmus long dang 'dra bas/ /snying po'i ngo bo dngos su mi mthong bas/ /mos spyis mjal zhing thos bsam gtan la phebs/ /de las skabs 'dir nyi 'od mthong ba bzhin/ /snying po mthong la rab tu nye bas na/ /tshul 'di theg pa'i rtser gyur 'phags pa yin/ /dar gyis bsgribs pa'i bum pa blta ba bzhin/ khams de'i sgrib pa rnam bcu rim byang nas/ /snying po'i bum pa rab tu gsal byed yin/ /de nas snying po'i ngo bo mthong ba la/ /mthong sgom 'dra yang dri ma'i bye brag gis/ /gsal dang mi gsal khyad par phye ba ni/ /nyi ltar snying po'i ngos ni gzhal ba yin/ /'od ltar gdangs sam snang ba'i cha nas ni/ /yon tan la yang rgya ni che chung yod/ /sgrib re dag pa'i stobs kyis yon tan re/ / snang 'gyur khang nang khang thog ri rtse yi/ /nyi 'od ji bzhin rgya ni che chung mthong*/ /yang na me long rdul gyis phyogs re nyid/ /dag pas gzugs brnyan snang ba 'phel ba bzhin/ /tshul 'di rig pa'i sgo ni mchog tu bzung*/ /'di nyid du ni snang ba gong nas gong*/ /lnga ldan dbyings nas lha yi skur snang ba/ /zhing khams brgya stong bye ba mthong ba ste/ /ting 'dzin yon tan gzungs sprin snying po can/ /dang po'i sar ni brgya phrag bcu gnyis gnas/ /gong nas gong mar stong khri 'bum phrag gnas/ /rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed dag gi tshul dang gcig /gsang sngags 'og mar dkyil 'khor lhun grub nyid/ /mngon sum mthong ba'i tshul yang 'di nyid do/ /de bas yang dag lam du phyin pa'i rtags/ /sa lam drod tshad yon tan mi bslu bas/ /sa bon 'phel las myu gu lo 'dab 'bras/

/rim gyis 'byung bzhin tshul 'du mtshungs par 'dod/ / dbyings la yod pa'i yon tan ji snyed pa/ /dri ma bral bas snang ba chos nyid yin/ /deng sang rnal 'byor chen por rlom pa dag /sa lam mi shes stong rkyang chad pa can/ /zang thal chig chod rtags tshad med ces ston/ /rmongs pa de kun ngan song mun par 'khyams/ /yang dag snying po'i don la skur 'debs phyir/ /lam ngan de 'dra thos par mi bya na/ /nyams su len cing bsam pa smos ci 'tshal/ /nam mkha' stong chad 'jig rten rgyang 'phen lugs/ /bde gshegs bka' dang 'gal bas ring du spang*/ /de phyir 'od gsal sa lam yon tan mchog /goms pa las ni mi bslu nges par 'byung*/ /'di 'dra'i lam zab gus pa'i gtsug gis bsten/ /de nas chos nyid zad pa'i snang ba ni/ /rab dag sa gsum kun rtog dri ma'i tshogs/ /mngon sum zad phyir rdos bcas lus zad phyir/ /'khrul snang zad phyir zad pa zhes ni brjod/ /snang ba ye shes 'od gsal chen po ste/ /yid dang 'dzin dang rnam par rtog pa nub/ /zhing dang ye shes chos la rang dbang thob/ /de phyir sgom lam chos nyid zad pa ni/ /rtsol bas bsgom med rang bzhin shugs kyis bgrod/ /rgya mtsho'i gzings dang khyung chen mkha' lding bzhin/ /skye dang 'jigs pa'i dbang thob don gnyis 'grub/ /mi rtog ye shes nyi ma gcig tu gnas/ /yon tan brjod 'das sems dang sems byung nub/ /phra ba sbyang phyir ting 'dzin ngang gis 'byung*/ /'di ni dag pa'i sems can rig 'dzin che/ /rnam kun ye shes zhing la spyod pa yin/ /de ltar lam mchog snang ba rnam bzhi yi/ /snang ba snying po'i gdangs gsal gong 'phel yang*/ /ngo bo mi 'gyur nyi ma'i snying po dang*/ /'od kyi phyogs bzhin kun tu shes par bya/ /dbyings 'di'i rang bzhin 'od gsal nyid ngo na/ /dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med pas rnam dbyer med/ /lam dang dri mar snang ba'i rnam pa la/ /glo bur dri bcas snang ba'i dbang gis phyed/

/'di ltar rnam par shes pa'i tshogs brgyad las/ /mthong sgom lam bsgyur rig pa tshad phebs su/ /nyon yid ldog pas 'khor ba'i mya ngan brgal/ /brgyad par yid shes ldog pas mi rtog thob/ /sgo lnga'i rnam shes ldog pas zhing khams dag /bcu par kun gzhi'i rnam shes ldog pa yis/ /ye shes pha rol phyin mchog gzungs sprin ldan/ /zad pa'i sar rdzogs rgyun mtha'i skad cig la/ /slob lam ldog pas kun gzhi'i bag chags kyi/ /sa yang rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin mchog

/rab tu thob pas dri ma kun dang bral/ /de phyir snang ba bzhi ldan lam gyi chos/ /ma lus rdzogs nas byang chub snying por 'grol/ /de nas mthar phyin 'bras bu'i grol tshul ni/ /lam dang lam gyi spang bya kun zad tshe/ /sems dang sems byung rten dang bcas pa kun/ /chos kyi dbyings su 'jug par rab zhi ste/ /nyi mkha' sgrib pa'i sprin tshogs dengs pa bzhin/ / chos sku'i dbyings na gzugs sku'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /'od gsal rang bzhin gang yin mngon du gyur/ /de tshe chos sku spros bral stong pa'i mkhar/ /'od gsal longs sku mtshan rdzogs dpe byad 'bar/ /sangs rgyas khams dang sangs rgyas byang chub ste/ /stobs bcu mi 'jig ma 'dres chos rnams dang*/ / thugs rje dpag med lhun grub yon tan tshogs/ /ji snyed ji bzhin gzigs pa mthar thug pas/ /bde gshegs yon tan rgya mtsho'i pha rol phyin/ /de lta'i ngang las gdul bya'i 'jig rten du/ /sna tshogs sprul sku mi zad 'phro ba ni/ / chu zla'i tshul bzhin kun nas snang ba ste/ /gdul bya'i las dang rgyal ba'i byin rlabs dag /rten 'brel dbang gis sna tshogs de ltar snang*/ /'di ni mdzad pa'i phrin las bsam mi khyab/ /sprul sku de dag snang ba'i dus nyid nas/ / gdul bya'i rang snang tsam de don la med/ /chu zla bzhin te med snang stong pa'i gzugs/ /ma skyes phyir na mi gnas 'gag pa med/ /med bzhin snang ste gdul bya'i mos blor snang*/ /ji ltar skar tshogs ston zla'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /chu nang rnyog dang bral bar snang na yang*/ /gza' skar med de de yi gzugs brnyan tsam/ /chu yi dwangs la rab tu snang bar byed/ /chu zla ma skyes 'gags par mi 'gyur ba/ /de ltar khyab bdag sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /gdul bya'i chu snod mtshor ni snang gyur nas/ /chos rab ston dang mngon 'byung dka' ba spyod/ /mya ngan 'das dang mi snang gyur pa yang*/ /'gro sems nyid de don la grub pa med/

/med bzhin snang ste thugs rje'i phrin las yin/ /des na gdul bya'i sems can chu dang ni/ /'dul byed zla ba'ang dpyad na dngos med de/ /'khrul snang med phyir 'dul byed ston pa med/ / med snang rmi lam sgyu ma'i tshul tsam du/ /snang srid snod bcud sprul sku'i ston pa rnams/ /ngo bo med la snang bar shes par mdzod/ khams de'i rang bzhin 'od gsal bas na de/ /sbyang bya'i gzhi dang sbyang bya'i dri ma dang*/ /sbyong byed chos dang sbyangs pa'i 'bras bu bzhir/ /gsang sngags mchog las de skad gsungs de'i phyir/ /sbyang gzhi 'od gsal snying po rnam dag nyid/ /rang rig dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med pa ni/ /dpe rnams kyis ni ji skad gsungs par zad/ /sbyang bya'i dri ma lus ngag yid gsum ste/ /'dod gzugs gzugs med mthong sgom spang bya'i chos/ khams de sgrib pa'i ngo bor skyes pa ni/ /nyi ma sprin bzhin de ltar gnas pa 'o/ /lus ky-is rang bzhin bsgribs te 'od gsal med/ /ngag gis thugs rje bsgribs te nye bar sgrel/ /sems kyis ngo bo bsgribs te khol bur bcings/ khams gsum bag chags bsags pas gnas lugs bsgribs/ /rtag tu 'khor bar bag chags 'khrul snang spyod/ /'di ltar sems dang sems la snang ngo cog /sgrib pa'i rang bzhin sbyang bya'i chos su gsungs/ /sbyong byed lam ni dri ma'i gnyen po ste/ /dbang dang gdams pa'i rang bzhin ji snyed pa'o/ /chos kun stong dang mtshan ma smon pa med/ /ma skyes nam mkha' rmi lam sgyu ma bzhin/ /'khrul snang bden pa med par shes byas nas/ /ma 'khrul 'od gsal 'pho 'gyur med bsgoms pas/ /brtson 'grus rab rnams tshe 'dir grol ba yin/ /goms pa 'bring rnams bar dor grol ba ste/ /lus sems rgya las rig pa grol ba na/ /bum pa chag pas mar me gsal ba bzhin/ /'di ltar gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa las/ /rtsol bas sbyangs dang tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa dang*/

/rang bzhin nyid kyis rtsa 'dab grol ba las/ /gdod ma'i ye shes mngon du gsal bar gsungs/ /de phyir tshe 'di'i snang ba nus pa na/ /rlung sems rim 'dus dbu mar thim pa las/ /'od gsal bde chen mi rtog 'char ba ste/ /de tshe ngo bo'i cha las skad cig bzhi/ /snang mched thob dang nye bar thob pa 'o/ /rang bzhin cha las phyir snang sangs rgyas zhing*/ /'od gsal stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams mthong*/ /thugs rje'i cha ni rig par skyes pas na/ /rang snang rig pa'i dbyings su gnas pa ni/ /skad cig gcig gis bye brag phyed pa'i mthus/ / skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas zhes gsungs/ /de tshe spyan dang mngon shes shar ba'i phyir/ /ma 'khrul 'khrul zhi 'khrul ba'i rgyur rig nas/ / dug nad sos pa'i rgyus la mkhas pa dag /phyi nas dug de za bar mi byed ltar/ /las kyi mngon shes rgyu 'bras rig pa yis/ /ma 'khrul gnas nas 'pho 'gyur med pa yin/ /de phyir bar dor grol ba'i tshul 'di ni/ /gsang chen kun las rab tu gsungs pas na/ /skal ldan rnams kyis gus pas bsten par bya/ /de ltar shar yang ma rig sems can pa/ /yang 'khor yang 'khrul shing rta'i 'phang lo 'dra/ /srid pa bar dor las kyi snang ba 'char/ / rdos bcas med pas de la brten pa'i rlung*/ /med phyir sems kyang de tshe med snyam na/ /de ltar ma yin spyir gyi lus la gsum/ /rdos bcas 'od gsal yid kyi rang bzhin la/ /sems kyi rgyud brten nyon mongs rlung sems rgyu/ / dang po rdos bcas sha khrag lus 'di ni/ /rags par grub phyir rlung yang rags pa'i phyir/ /sems kyang rags pas shin tu rgod pa'i phyir/ /gdul dka' kun rtog can zhes rab tu bstan/ /'dod lha lha min mi dang dud 'gro sogs/ /'dod pa'i khams la rang bzhin shas che 'o/ /'di thul ba la ye shes lhag par gsal/ /'od gsal 'ja' tshon lus ni gzugs kyi khams/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa'i lha la mngon du gyur/

/'byung bzhi dwangs pa'i rang bzhin 'ja' tshon lus/ /sngon gyi dge 'bras stobs las byung ba la/ /sems kyi rgyud rten rags par med pas na/ /rlung sems zhi ba bsam gtan rnam pa bzhi/ /bag chags bcas pa'i sems dang sems byung rten/ / bag la nyal phyir rab tu ches phra'i phyir/ /rags pa med phyir sa bon tshul du ldan/ /de yang 'khor ba'i sa pas bsdus pa'i phyir/ /bsam gtan de yi srid pa 'ching byed yin/ /yid kyi lus de g.yo dang mi g.yo gnyis/ /g.yo ba bar do'i 'gro ba nyid dang ni/ /mnar med la sogs dmyal ba kha cig bzhin/ / rdos bcas med kyang yod pa 'dzin pa ste/ /rmi lam nang gi snang ba de dang 'dra/ /rmi lam yid lus bde sdug myong ba ltar/ /dmyal ba bar do'i bde sdug tshul de bzhin/ /rang rang las dang nyon mongs dbang gis 'ching*/ /g.yo byed yid lus bag chags brten de la/ /bag chags rlung yod rlung des sems snang gis/ /'khrul snang 'khrul 'dzin ma lus ji snyed 'byung*/ /de phyir g.yo byed yid lus nyid shes bya/ /mi g.yo yid kyi lus ni ting 'dzin du/ / sems dang sems byung nub par gnas pa ste/ /dbye na gzugs med yid kyi lus dang ni/ /nyan rang lhag med 'gog pa'i mnyam gzhag ste/ /ma rig pa yi bag chags ma spangs phyir/ /re zhig zhi yang phyi nas ldang dgos so/ /de tshe che phra'i shes pa mi gsal ba/ /zhi gnas ngang du rang bzhin gnas pa'i dpe/ / 'o ma'i nang na dngos su mar med kyang*/ /ches phra'i dbyings na yod bzhin bag la nyal/ /shin tu phra mos snying po sgrib pa'i phyir/ /phyi nas skye 'gyur de ltar gnas pas na/ /yid kyi lus la sems kyi rgyud brten nas/ /bde gshegs snying po'i khams sgrib gyur pa yin/ /des na 'di kun rab tu shes pa gces/ /rig pas 'dor phyir lus zhes bshad pa ste/ /bde gshegs sku ni mi g.yo 'pho 'gyur med/ /rang bzhin 'dus ma byas phyir lhun grub phyir/

/ ( sprul skur snang ba don la ma grub pas/ /'khor bar yang 'khrul shing rta'i 'phang lo 'dra/ /srid pa'i bar dor las kyi snang ba 'char/ /rdos bcas med par de la brten pa'i rlung*/ /med phyir sems kyang de tsho med snyam pa/ /de ltar ma yin spyir gyi lus la gsum/ /rdos bcas 'od gsal yid kyi rang bzhin la/ ['di'i bar rkang pa bdun a 'dzam par mar mi bzhugs pas dpyod] /'pho dang 'gyur ba med ces gsungs pa yin/ /rnal 'byor grub pa 'od kyi lus de nyid/ /sgrib pa spang phyir snying po'i rang bzhin phyir/ /bsam gtan lus dang khyad par shin tu che/ /rnam smin bag chags dag las skyes pa dang*/ /bag chags ma skyes lhun grub khyad par 'phags/ /gang phyir rang bzhin sprul sku'i bgrod tshul yang*/ /rang snang dag phyir mngon sum byin rlabs phyir/ /ngang gis snang ba rig pa'i yon tan yin/ /de phyir chos tshul rin chen snying po'i don/ /'od gsal mngon sum lhun grub ngo mtshar 'phags/ /de ltar rab zab mdo rgyud snying po dang*/ /mthun sbyar yid ches mkhas pa'i 'jug ngogs 'di/ /theg mchog 'od gsal snying po'i rnal 'byor pa/ /klong chen rab 'byams bzang pos legs par bkod/ /dge ba de yis mkha' mnyam sems can kun/ / lhun grub yangs pa chen po'i gnas bgrod nas/ /sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa yis/ /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub par shog /gnyis ka'i yang yig lung don mthun pa nam mkha' klong chen zhes bya ba/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis bkod pa rdzogs so/ /dge'o/ / dge'o/ /dge'o// ༈ nam mkha' klong chen gyi bsdus don 'od kyi phreng ba bzhugs so/ / nam mkha' klong chen gyi gnas rgya cher bshad pa la gsum ste/ man ngag bshad pa la 'jug pa rgyu'i don/ lus dngos kyi don/ yongs su rdzogs pa mjug gi don/ dang po la gsum ste/ mtshan gyi don/ mdo dang rgyas pa'i phyag gi don/

brtsam par dam bca' ba'o/ / spyi don gnyis pa lus dngos kyi don rgyas par bshad pa la gsum ste/ lam gzhi dbyings kyi ngo bo/ lam gyi rang bzhin/ lam mthar phyin pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /dang po la dgu ste/ dbyings kyi go don ngos gzung*/ yod kyang ma mthong*/ yod pa'i dpe dgod/ kun tu bzang po'i grol tshul gtan la dbab/ ma rig sems can gyi 'khrul tshul ngos gzung ba dang*/ nyon mongs kyi mtshon dpe gsal bar bshad pa'o/ /don gnyis pa lam dngos kyis gtan la dbab pa la gnyis te/ lam spyi'i 'brel dgod pa dang*/ bye brag rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /de la gnyis te ngo bo khregs chod kyi rang bzhin spyir bstan pa dang*/ gnas mdo spyi sgos/de las 'khor 'das kyi 'char tshul bye brag tu byed/ dbyings kyi/ lhun grub thod rgal gyi rang bzhin bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ 'khor ba 'khrul pa'i rang snang don la yod ma myong bar gtan la dbab pa/ med snang mtshon dpe gzhi 'bras stong pa chen por thag gcad/ gzung 'dzin gzhi nas dag pa gdod ma'i dbyings su la bzla ba'o/ /gnyis pa lhun grub thod rgal gyi rang bzhin bye brag tu bshad pa la bdun te/ thod rgal don gyi 'brel dgod pa/ gdangs gsum so so'i rang bzhin ngos gzung ba/ snang bzhi so so'i 'char tshul las/ chos nyid mngon sum gyi snang ba spyir dgod/ nyams gong 'phel gyi snang ba bye brag tu bshad/ rig pa tshad phebs kyi snang ba rdzogs par bstan/ chos nyid zad pa'i snang ba gtan la dbab/ de thams cad kyi don bsdu ba'o/ /rig pa tshad phebs kyi snang ba rdzogs par bstan pa la don bdun/ ngo bo ngos gzung*/ mtshon dpes gtan la dbab/ mtshon dpe'i dogs pa dgag /gsal ba'i dpe brjod/ yon tan gyi 'char tshul bstan/ rmongs pa'i log rtog dgag /yang dag pa'i don bsdu ba'o/ /de thams cad kyi don bsdu ba la gnyis te/ snang bzhi'i gdangs kyi 'phel 'grib ngos gzung ba dang*/

kun gzhi rnam shes dang bcas pa'i ldog tshul gtan la dbab pa'o/ /don gsum pa mthar phyin pa'i 'bras bu la bdun te/ dag pa gnyis ldan gyi sa ngos gzung*/ sku gsum lhun grub kyi 'bras bu gtan la dbab pa'o/ /thugs rje phrin las kyi mdzad pa so sor dbye ba mdzad tshul sprul sku'i mthun dpe gtan la dbab/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed kyi go don so sor blang*/ lus gsum so so'i rnam par dbye ba bstan/ zhar la sprul sku'i bgrod tshul gtan la dbab pa'o/ /sbyang gzhi sbyong byed kyi go don so sor blang ba la bzhi ste/ sbyang gzhi rigs kyi rang bzhin/ sbyang bya dri ma'i chos/ sbyong byed lam gyi ngo bo/ sbyangs 'bras 'bras bu'i rang bzhin bstan pa'o/ /lus gsum so so'i rnam dbye bstan pa la gsum ste/ spyi'i 'grel dgod/ bye brag tu so sor bshad/ the tshom gyi gnas spang ba'o/ /gnyis pa bye brag so sor bshad pa la gsum ste/ rdos bcas sha khrag gi lus/ dngas pa 'od kyi lus/ dran pa yid kyi lus so/ /de la gnyis te/ rnam rtog yid kyi lus dang*/ rtog med ting nge 'dzin gyi lus so/ / gsum pa'i the tshom gyi gnas spang ba la gnyis te/ lus dang sku'i khyad par bstan pa la/ 'od lus gnyis kyi khyad par bstan pa'o/ /spyi don gsum pa yongs su rdzogs pa mjug gi don la gsum ste/ rtsom pa po'i gang zag bstan pa/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba/ mtshan rdzogs pa mjug gi don gsal bar bshad pa'o/ /gnyis ka'i rgyab yig nam mkha' klong chen gyi 'grel pa bsdus 'grel 'od kyi phreng ba zhes bya ba/ rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis bum thang thar pa gling du sbyar ba dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (10)gnyis ka'i yang yig nam mkha' klong chen/ - PAGE 24 -- PAGE 25 -- PAGE 10 -
